From January 12th to January 18th, we celebrate Virginia School Principals Appreciation Week. When we recognize Virginia School Principals Appreciation Week each January, we recognize the remarkable leaders who drive the success of our schools each and every day.

One important component of the budget planning process includes the Capital Improvement Program, or CIP. As you may know, the CIP is a management tool for planning the capital improvement projects needed to house students adequately. Annual review of the CIP enables the division to address changing enrollment patterns and utilize facilities in ways consistent with sound educational practices.

The CIP provides a 10-year blueprint for new construction, renovations, and specific projects in response to our student body. The CIP meeting is scheduled for the evening of January 15th, and I want to encourage you to visit our website at pwcs.edu for more details about this meeting and to review the remaining meeting dates and times for the 2025-26 budget.
